description_en: Creates an Automatic Speech Recognition (ASR) transcription task from a recording file
description_zh: 上传录音文件，创建ASR创建转换任务
kebab_example: aliyun dyvmsapi cloud-create-asr --enterprise-id 7000002 --call-type 2 --record-file 7000002-20170320140327-1581-1500-record-sip-2-148998.366 --record-type record --record-side 0 --unique-id sip-2-1489989807.36601 --main-unique-id sip-2-1489989807.36601 --region cn-hangzhou
name: CloudCreateAsr

parameters.help_en: The ID of the call center
parameters.name: enterprise_id

parameters.help_en: The call type. Valid values: `1` (inbound call), `2` (webcall), `4` (preview outbound call), `5` (predictive outbound call), `6` (agent-initiated outbound call), and `9` (internal call)
parameters.help_zh: 通话类型；1:呼入,2:webcall,4:预览外呼,5:预测外呼,6:主叫外呼,9:内部呼叫
parameters.name: call_type

parameters.help_en: The audio file type. Valid values: `record` (recording) and `voicemail`
parameters.help_zh: 语音文件类型,取值：record,voicemail 说明：record是录音， voicemail是留言
parameters.name: record_type

parameters.help_en: The recording channel type. Valid values for track-based recording: `0` (mixed audio), `1` (customer side), `2` (agent side), and `3` (both the customer and agent sides)
parameters.help_zh: 录音通道类型；取值范围：0：混音 1：分线录音时客户侧,2：分线录音时座席侧,3:分线录音时客户侧和座席侧
parameters.name: record_side

parameters.help_en: The unique ID of the sub-channel
parameters.name: unique_id

parameters.help_en: The unique ID of the main channel
parameters.name: main_unique_id

parameters.help_en: Specifies whether to use an MP3 file for transcription if the corresponding WAV file has expired. Valid values: `0` (No, default) and `1` (Yes). If you set this parameter to `1`, the system automatically uses the MP3 file for transcription when the WAV file is unavailable. In this case, the recording channel type in the result is set to `mixed audio`. Note that a mixed-audio MP3 file cannot separate the two speakers, while a dual-channel MP3 file can
parameters.help_zh: 当wav过期时，是否支持使用mp3进行转写；0-不支持（默认）；1-代表支持，如果通话wav过期，则自动使用mp3转写，转写结果中通道类型会被设置为混音类型；混音mp3无法区分两侧，双声道mp3可以区分两侧内容
parameters.name: support_mp3
